The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons' description reads «ST SIMEON THE GOD RECEIVER, MOSCOW (?), OLD BELIEVERS' WORKSHOP, CIRCA 1800». Θεοδόχος, the God-receiver, is the epithet of the elder of the Presentation alone, and separates him from Symeon the Stylite and Symeon the New Theologian. Commons describes it: ST SIMEON THE GOD RECEIVER     MOSCOW (?), OLD BELIEVERS' WORKSHOP, CIRCA 1800 31 by 26 cm. 3,000-5,000 GBP    Label: Old label from the Church of His Imperial Majesty’s Composite Infantry Regiment and a small metal plaque with number “520” on the reverse.
